name: auto-router-companion
description: Status bar for auto-router: the model and effort Claude Code is really using, "sonnet (medium)", and the plan use; plus an "Add to Claude Code" Explorer menu.

autoRouter.gatewayUrl.description: Where the auto-router gateway answers (GET /state). Loopback only.

autoRouter.legacyStack.description: Also support the Copilot Chat stack (LiteLLM): its context status and the automatic new chat. Off by default.

autoRouter.stateFile.description: Legacy stack only: path to data/context-state.json.

autoRouter.autoNewChat.description: Legacy stack only: open a new chat automatically when the context is nearly full.

autoRouter.autoSend.description: Legacy stack only: send the continuation prompt automatically.
